# proctest

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/immutago/pkg/proc/proctest"
```

Package proctest provides test helpers for supervised processes.

## func Root

```go
func Root(t testing.TB) *proc.Supervisor
```

Root returns a root supervisor that stops when t ends. It fails t if the tree does not stop in 5 s.
